model_interpretation.claim: With 256 threads per block and an items_per_block tile of 512, a grid-stride loop assigns up to two targets to each thread for larger inputs. Fewer threads and CTAs may reduce scheduling overhead, though the additional sequential target work per thread could instead hurt throughput. The pairwise arithmetic order and single-kernel interface remain unchanged; the controller must measure correctness and the prescribed geometric mean.
